raw_text: Russia is facing its most serious internal security crisis in decades as Wagner Group mercenaries continue their march toward Moscow. President Putin has addressed the nation calling it a stab in the back and vowing punishment. The Wagner column has reportedly reached within 200km of Moscow. International leaders are monitoring the situation closely.
